description: Albacross leverages proprietary data to help B2B companies understand their leads better. By using data from their free lead generation tool used by thousands of companies across the globe, Albacross is building a global ‘business graph,’ opening up their platform and providing valuable services to both enterprises and SME’s.
tagline: Revolutionizing B2B Sales with Data-Driven Account Targeting

description: Aviant is redefining drone technology by delivering advanced aerial solutions tailored for industrial, commercial, and security applications. Their autonomous drones are equipped with state-of-the-art sensors and intelligent analytics, enabling businesses to capture precise, real-time data for enhanced operational efficiency and safety. By seamlessly integrating cutting-edge hardware with innovative software, Aviant empowers organizations to make smarter, data-driven decisions in dynamic environments
tagline: Redefining Last-Mile Delivery with Drone Technology

description: Berget provides sovereign AI infrastructure that lets organisations run powerful models without sending sensitive data to US cloud providers. Through their own GPU capacity and API, teams can deploy AI fast, securely, and at scale. It’s built for regulated industries and the public sector where control and compliance are non-negotiable.
tagline: Sovereign AI Infrastructure, Built to Scale

description: Carla is the leading Swedish e-commerce marketplace for second-hand electric vehicles, ensuring a seamless experience whether you’re looking to lease, buy, or sell. The company guarantees swift pickup and home delivery to customers’ doorsteps within as little as 72 hours across Sweden, streamlining the transition to a more sustainable mode of transportation. With its commitment to quality, convenience, and eco-conscious practices, Carla empowers drivers to embrace electric mobility without compromising on service or peace of mind.
tagline: The Leading Marketplace for Second-Hand Electric Vehicles

description: CodeScene’s groundbreaking platform utilizes advanced patented algorithms and artificial intelligence to provide developers with actionable insights into their codebases. CodeScene’s analyzes are automatically adapted to each customer and the recommendations are personalized by how their software organization works. This helps teams identify technical debt, optimize software architecture, and improve overall code quality.
tagline: AI-Driven Code Health Analysis for Eliminating Tech Debt

description: Corsmed revolutionizes medical imaging by drastically reducing MRI scanning times from hours to minutes. Their innovative platform leverages advanced imaging algorithms and state-of-the-art technology to streamline the MRI process, delivering faster diagnostics and significantly enhancing patient care. By transforming conventional MRI workflows, Corsmed empowers healthcare providers to improve clinical efficiency and meet the growing demand for rapid, accurate imaging
tagline: Software-Only 10x Faster MRI Simulation and Training Platform

description: Deckmatch is a holistic deal evaluation tool that empowers investors to scrutinize every detail of potential opportunities with unparalleled clarity. Its platform automatically calculates the bottoms-up market size, competitive analysis, management team backgrounds, and instantly crafts an entire deal memo, based on realtime company information. The platform also allows investors to create AI workflows for deal evaluations and extract company-specific data from the Deckmatch API for use across their tech stacks. Additionally, Deckmatch has launched AlphaLens, a private markets search platform that uses AI-driven search to extract product insights, building a picture of any company based on its product offerings; this data is the underpinning of Deckmatch's competitive analysis capabilities.
tagline: Automated Deal & Product Analysis for Investors

description: Fika Jobs is a Stockholm-based, video-first hiring platform that replaces the traditional CV with AI-powered video conversations. Candidates complete a roughly 10-minute interview with an AI agent, which is automatically turned into short video clips and a discoverable profile that employers can browse and revisit as new roles open. Free for job seekers, Fika charges employers only on a successful hire, and anonymises attributes like age, gender and ethnicity during matching to support fairer decisions. Named after the Swedish tradition of fika, the platform is built on the belief that meaningful professional connections start with conversation, not paperwork.
tagline: Making Hiring Human Again with AI Video Interviews

description: FirstQFM is developing machine learning foundation models that make quantum processors more stable, efficient, and reliable, improving their performance without requiring any hardware redesign. These models leverage proprietary training protocols and data partnerships with leading quantum hardware developers to automatically optimize system performance and scalability.
tagline: Building the Performance Layer for Quantum Computing

description: Greenely is a smart energy app that empowers households to manage their energy consumption effectively. By connecting various home energy devices through a single platform, users can optimize their energy usage, save costs, and even earn money by contributing to the stability of Sweden's electricity grid. With over 220,000 users, Greenely differentiates itself from traditional energy companies by offering a dynamic pricing model and real-time data tracking, enabling customers to make informed decisions about their energy consumption. The app integrates with over 40 devices, including electric vehicles and solar panels, positioning Greenely as a leader in the energy management market.
tagline: Leading the Smart Energy Revolution for Households

description: Health Integrator is a digital health coaching service dedicated to preventing chronic diseases and mental health issues by promoting sustainable lifestyle changes. Their platform offers personalized health coaching, a marketplace for health products and services, and individualized health profiles to help individuals achieve better health outcomes.
tagline: Scaling Preventative Healthcare with Personalized Plans

description: Heja is a sports team management and communication app designed to simplify organization and communication among team members, including coaches, parents, and players. The platform is free to use and has gained significant traction, with over 350,000 teams utilizing the app across more than 50 countries. Heja differentiates itself by providing a user-friendly interface that consolidates team schedules, messaging, and availability tracking, thereby reducing the clutter of traditional communication methods. The company aims to foster a positive impact on youth sports by making team management accessible and efficient for everyone involved.
tagline: Next Generation Social Platform for Youth Sports

description: Hypertype supports and transforms SMEs communication by leveraging AI agents to analyse and optimize every conversation and document within your organisation. Their intelligent platform integrates seamlessly with existing workflows to automatically extract critical insights, enabling data-driven decision-making and enhanced collaboration. Hypertype aims to boost productivity, streamline communication, and build a more agile, connected workforce in today’s digital landscape.
tagline: AI Agent for Support Automation

description: Insurello is a licensed insurance broker that simplifies the process of obtaining compensation for insurance claims. They assist clients in identifying hidden insurance policies, managing claims, and ensuring rightful compensation for injuries or damages. Their business model is performance-based, charging clients only if they successfully secure compensation, which differentiates them in the market. Insurello operates in various sectors including work-related incidents, traffic accidents, and sports injuries, and has established a strong presence in the insurance mediation space.
tagline: Automating Insurance Claim Recoveries for Maximum Payouts

description: Insurely is a provider of open finance solutions that offers real-time access to insurance, pension, and investment data. The company aims to enhance customer experiences in the banking and insurance sectors by leveraging data aggregation capabilities, allowing financial institutions to create new use cases and improve customer engagement. With a focus on transparency and collaboration, Insurely is expanding its services across Europe, working with leading insurers and banks to facilitate seamless financial experiences. Their innovative approach positions them as a key player in the evolving landscape of open finance, driven by regulatory changes and consumer demand for better financial services.
tagline: Enabling Real-Time Access to Insurance, Pension and Investment Data

description: IntuiCell is building the “brain” for robots and autonomous agents that need to handle unpredictable environments. Instead of training on massive datasets, their AI learns through real-world experience and sensory feedback — and keeps improving after deployment.
tagline: Decentralised Sensory Learning for the Next Generation of Adaptive AI

description: IPercept helps production and maintenance teams unlock the full potential of industrial metalworking (CNC) machines, which represents the backbone of manufacturing. With their predictive AI powered platform, IPercept aims to eliminate the €1 trillion annual productivity loss that occurs due to unexpected downtime, quality issues, and inefficiencies.
tagline: Predictive AI Platform Purpose Built for Industrial (CNC) Machines

description: Ivy is an AI-first open-source .NET framework that helps developers build business applications in minutes. They can take (almost) any database and generate a complete internal app in minutes. It is secure and ready to be deployed in a cloud of your choice.
tagline: AI-First Open-Source .NET Framework for Building Internal Apps

description: Lightbringer is revolutionizing the patenting process with its AI-driven platform, designed to simplify and accelerate intellectual property protection for innovators. By combining advanced AI technology with expert patent attorney support, the platform empowers companies of all sizes to efficiently transform their ideas into protected assets, saving up to 70% of the time traditionally required.
tagline: AI Powered Patent Lawyer

description: Mindler is a digital mental health service that connects patients with licensed psychologists through video calls and an app, offering immediate access to therapy without waiting times. Their model includes a patient fee of 100 SEK, with a focus on evidence-based treatments like IKBT (Internet-based Cognitive Behavioral Therapy). Mindler differentiates itself by providing multilingual support and a user-friendly platform, having served over 150,000 patients since its inception. The company positions itself as a leader in the digital mental health space, emphasizing accessibility and quality of care.
tagline: Scaling Mental Healthcare with Digital Accessibility

description: Motorica has developed a transformer-based AI model trained on thousands of hours of proprietary motion capture, capable of generating high-fidelity character animation at scale. Animation is one of the most time-consuming and expensive parts of production, and Motorica can enable cost reductions exceeding 90 percent of the animation budget.
tagline: Generative AI accelerating Mocap

description: Mynt is a comprehensive solution for managing company expenses, offering corporate cards linked to accounting and credit. It provides features like automated receipt matching, virtual cards, and integration with leading accounting systems. Mynt differentiates itself with its user-friendly interface and smart functionalities, catering to various industries including tech, construction, and healthcare. The platform is designed for businesses of all sizes, allowing for real-time transaction monitoring and individual spending limits, making it a valuable tool for financial management.
tagline: Reinventing Expense Management for Modern SMEs

description: Normative offers a complete carbon accounting solution, blending rigorous calculations with expert advisory services to navigate evolving regulations like CSRD and CDP. Their all-in-one platform simplifies data collection and compliance, allowing businesses to focus on implementing effective reduction strategies and driving sustainable business value.
tagline: SaaS for Enterprise Carbon Accounting and Net-Zero Goals

description: Omocom is transforming the insurance industry with on-demand microinsurance tailored for the circular economy. By enabling coverage only when items are in use, Omocom reduces transaction risks and promotes sustainable consumption patterns. With cutting-edge algorithms developed alongside Swedish researchers, the company empowers sharing platforms to extend product lifecycles and drive the adoption of circular business models.
tagline: Enabling the Circular Economy at Scale by Innovating Insurance

description: Open Payments offers a single unified API to connect you to multiple banks, removing the complexity of diverse integrations. Build the best financial products and services with streamlined payment flows, real-time cash flow visibility, and simplified account reconciliation.
tagline: Building the Backbone for Open Banking Across Europe

description: Opper is an integrated platform designed for developers to build production-grade generative AI features and agents quickly. It offers a comprehensive toolbox that includes structured, model-independent LLM calls, automated interoperability between LLMs, data integration, and real-time tracing of AI interactions. With a powerful API and SDKs, Opper enables developers to optimize quality, security, cost, and speed of LLMs in production, positioning itself as a developer's end-to-end LLM implementation platform.
tagline: LLMops Integration Platform

description: Petbuddy Group is redefining pet care by building sustainable, innovative brands that prioritize the health of pets, the satisfaction of pet parents, and the well-being of the planet. With a global presence spanning over 50 countries, PBG combines eco-friendly practices with premium nutrition and care products to shape a healthier, happier future for pets worldwide.
tagline: Redefining Sustainable Pet Care for the Eco-Conscious Consumer

description: Photoncycle makes homes energy-autonomous year-round for a transparent price, while creating a balanced energy system for all. Our first-of-its-kind energy technology is being piloted with the largest house builder in Norway. It is predicted to become the obvious choice for powering homes worldwide when large-scale manufacturing begins in 2027.
tagline: Developing a Novel Solid-State Hydrogen Energy System

description: Pley's platform simplifies porting of mobile games and enables them to be integrated on almost any website. Complete with integrations to popular destinations like CrazyGames and Discord, and including tools like ready-to-go gamesites, automatic account linking, and global payments.
tagline: Game Distribution Platform for Mobile Games to the Web

description: ReCarber is driving the expansion of bio-CCS (biogenic carbon capture and storage) in the Nordics to help meet global climate goals. With a unique business model, deep sector expertise, and a specialised software platform, the company simplifies the value chain, enabling faster project deployment and lower costs.
tagline: Platform for Accelerated Carbon Removals using BECCS

description: Rocky Road is building the next-generation social gaming network for communities around the globe, including schools, towns, neighborhoods and cities. Founded by the innovative team behind QuizUp, which captivated over 100 million users worldwide, their new vision is to design games that foster genuine, real-world connections among players. By blending immersive technology with intuitive design, Rocky Road is creating the first hyperlocal social gaming platform.
tagline: Next-Generation Social Gaming Network for Global Communities

description: RUN is a data driven investment company supporting the creator generation with offices in Los Angeles and Stockholm. We are dedicated to empowering independent artists by providing funding through a transparent, algorithm-driven model.
tagline: Automated Investments Into Digital Content

description: Starmony is revolutionizing music creation by empowering anyone to make and release songs using just their voice. With its innovative platform, Starmony enables artists to create music anytime, anywhere, while connecting with a vibrant community of creators. Whether you're a budding artist or an experienced producer, Starmony offers tools to turn ideas into hits and share them with the world.
tagline: Scaling Global Music Creation and Collaboration

description: With Turbotic’s AI Assistant, businesses can harness the full potential of data analysis to drive large-scale transformation. By streamlining AI and automation initiatives, Turbotic enables companies to quickly seize opportunities for greater efficiency and impact.
tagline: AI Assistant for Large-Scale Transformation

description: Vården is a dynamic marketplace designed to connect people with the right healthcare provider, simplifying the search and booking process for quality care. By connecting all healthcare providers in one place, Vården makes it effortless for users to navigate the often-complex healthcare landscape.
tagline: Marketplace for Accessing Healthcare Services

description: Vibrant's vision is to create an integrated payment solution with a seamless experience for businesses that supports their growth by empowering consumers with the flexibility to choose their desired payment method.
tagline: Embedded Payment Infrastructure Empowering Digital Transactions

description: xNomad is revolutionizing retail by curating dynamic pop-up experiences that bring together brands and property owners, transforming vacant spaces into high-impact storefronts on flexible terms. By bridging the gap between online and physical retail, xNomad enables businesses to engage customers with immersive, hands-on interactions, while helping landlords fill empty venues quickly and profitably. Already serving customers across Europe, North America, and Asia, they aim to become the go-to global platform for short-term retail, ultimately reshaping how we think about commercial real estate.
tagline: Europe’s Leading Platform for On-Demand Retail Spaces

description: Founded by health care professionals in Sweden in 2021, Yazen is pioneering a revolutionary approach to obesity treatment through digital healthcare. Combining groundbreaking weight loss medications with comprehensive lifestyle guidance, Yazen offers a holistic, data-driven solution. With over 20,000 active users who have collectively lost 200+ tons, Yazen stands out in treating the global obesity epidemic. Its innovative model provides personalised obesity programmes through an advanced yet user-friendly app, enhancing access to specialist care including doctors, coaches, dietitians, psychologists and physiotherapists.
tagline: Europe's Leading Holistic Digital Health Solution for Combating Obesity

description: Founded in 2016 by engineers and computer scientists from MIT and Danish military intelligence, Muninn has been changing the way companies approach cybersecurity with their AI-driven NDR (network detection and response) platform. Muninn autonomously recognizes and responds to potential breaches of enterprise networks, helping safeguard large enterprises and governments. Muninn was acquired by Logpoint in October 2024.
tagline: Machine Learning Powered Cyber Security Threat Detection Platform.
